outcomeNote: mishna recording a dispute between the anonymous tanna and R' Yehuda

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁנָּדְרָה בְּנָזִיר, וְהָיְתָה שׁוֹתֶה בְּיַיִן וּמִטַּמְּאָה לְמֵתִים — הֲרֵי זֶה סוֹפֶגֶת אֶת הָאַרְבָּעִים. הֵפֵר לָהּ בַּעְלָהּ, וְהִיא לֹא יָדְעָה שֶׁהֵפֵר לָהּ בַּעְלָהּ, וְהָיְתָה שׁוֹתָה בְּיַיִן וּמִטַּמְּאָה לְמֵתִים — אֵינָהּ סוֹפֶגֶת אֶת הָאַרְבָּעִים. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אִם אֵינָהּ סוֹפֶגֶת אֶת הָאַרְבָּעִים — תִּסְפּוֹג מַכַּת מַרְדּוּת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a woman who vowed to be a nazirite, and» she transgressed her vow since «she was drinking wine and rendering herself ritually impure by» contact with «the dead, she incurs the forty» lashes for each of the Torah prohibitions she transgressed. If «her husband nullified her» vow, «and she did not know that her husband had nullified her» vow, «and she was drinking wine and rendering herself impure by» contact with «the dead, she does not incur the forty» lashes, as she is no longer a nazirite. «Rabbi Yehuda says:» Even «if she does not incur the forty» lashes by Torah law, «she should incur lashes for rebelliousness [makat mardut],» an extrajudicial punishment imposed by the Sages, for her intention to commit a transgression, since she believed that it was prohibited to her.

moves.summary: a transgressing nazirite woman incurs forty lashes
if nullified without her knowledge, no forty lashes

moves.about: whether a woman who transgressed unaware that her vow was nullified goes unpunished or receives lashes for rebelliousness

edges.about: whether a woman who transgressed unaware that her vow was nullified goes unpunished or receives lashes for rebelliousness

positions.claim: she incurs forty lashes if not nullified; none if nullified without her knowledge
if not forty lashes, she receives lashes for rebelliousness
